europe_now.title: Russian Drone Strikes Passenger Train Near Polish Border
europe_now.summary: A passenger train traveling from Kyiv to Warsaw was struck by a Russian drone near the Polish border amidst ongoing regional attacks. The incident has raised security concerns regarding infrastructure near NATO's borders.

europe_now.title: Sweden Holds General Election with Far-Right Gains Expected
europe_now.summary: Swedes have headed to the polls in a closely contested general election that could potentially position the far right within the government. Observers across Europe are closely monitoring the outcome as a potential turning point for domestic politics.

sources.headline: Sweden election: A turning point for the far right?
Swedes vote in close general election that could usher far right into government

top_stories.title: German Protests Following Elections
top_stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators gathered across Germany to protest against the far-right Alternative for Germany party following its recent electoral success. The rallies reflect deep societal divisions and widespread public pushback against far-right political gains.

sources.headline: Germany: Thousands rally against far-right after AfD victory

top_stories.title: UK Political Funding Investigation
top_stories.summary: British police have launched a formal investigation into a substantial donation made to Reform UK. Investigators are examining the origins and legality of the multimillion-pound funding.

sources.headline: UK: Police probe £72 million donation to Reform UK
